f.item: THE GAUGE-SELECTION THEOREM, formalized — B918's observer's-place law (proved for V/HIER at one gauge) vs. B1076's 3-gauge coboundary sweep {D2, χ_a, χ_b}
f.headline: Every arithmetic ingredient checks out exactly, independently re-verified in-sandbox this session (PARI/GP nfinit+idealprimedec on K=ℚ[s]/(s³−12s−5): disc=6237=3⁴·7·11 both as poly-disc and field-disc, index²=1; 413=7·59, 3047=11·277; 7 and 11 each split as one unramified deg-1 place plus one tamely-ramified (e=2) deg-1 place, both totally distinct from 3's total ramification; 59,277,953 each split unramified [1,2] with Kronecker(77,·)=−1). The selection pattern the house prompt names is real and precisely as stated: among {D2,χ_a,χ_b}, only D2's λ-denominator is a bare unramified value prime; χ_a's and χ_b's each carry exactly one of K's two non-3 ramified primes, which are exactly the exponents C28 (banked, Gate-5-clean) already calls "unmeasured." But "THE GAUGE-SELECTION THEOREM" as a capital-T law is not itself banked anywhere: B918's proof is about V/HIER, not λ, and covers exactly one gauge (D2); B931's mechanism that explains D2's 953 (a resultant-birth divisor map) has no χ_a/χ_b analogue anywhere in the repo; and — unlike its two sibling coset-wide candidates (CCC=3!·λ, disc-kernel=77), which B1076 itself ran through a designed MB12 control sweep in this same session — this specific denominator-purity criterion has never been control-tested. What is earned is an exact, adversarially-consistent, structurally non-trivial (element-invariant, not field-invariant, so not automatically vacuous the way 77 was) OBSERVATION with a clean 1-of-3 pass rate. What is not earned is the word "theorem" for the selection claim itself.

claims.statement: ELEMENT 1 — THE LAW'S EXACT BANKED SCOPE. B918's OBSERVER'S-PLACE THEOREM (LAW_MAP row: '[α_μ]=[α_gen]=[α_κ]=[α_V]=C untwisted, vacuum=C⁻¹ … den(V) = 𝔭₁(953)⁴ exactly — the hierarchy's pole entirely on the unique degree-one place; prime roles 953-pole/421493-trace/1129-e₂; structure primes numerator, value prime denominator') was proved for exactly ONE object, in exactly ONE gauge. The object: V ∈ K, the exact algebraic root of HIER(x) = 953⁴x³ − 2⁸3⁹·13·421493x² + 2²¹3⁸·17·1129x − 2³²3¹¹ (irreducible, disc squarefree-kernel {7,11}), equivalently (B923) the diagonal CCl coupling invariant V_ccl, shown coefficient-for-coefficient identical to V(ρ). The gauge: the τ-twisted Hermitian form H′=H₊·D2 — B916's 'solo/belt gauge,' which is B1076's coset element 'D2' verbatim (not a different D2). In the only OTHER gauge examined before B1076 (canonical H₊, B1076's 'I'), B923 shows the same invariant collapses to the rational, generation-degenerate (x+3)³ — no cubic field, no denominator ideal, nothing for the law to be tested against. So the law's proved domain, before this week's sweep, was a domain of size one. Certificate chain (exact tier throughout, all re-verified in this session): HIER pinned exactly + V(ρ) an exact root certificate with HIER(V(ρ))≡0 mod μ exactly (B918); the char-poly valuation argument confining den(V) to places over 953, Hensel-lifted to p⁴⁰ over a round_two integral basis giving v_𝔭₁(V)=−4, v_𝔭₂(V)=0, norm-checked exactly (B918); B923's independent closure 953⁴·charpoly(V_ccl)=HIER exactly, turning B918's own registered numeric floor (7.3e-88) into an identity; B937's re-derivation of the whole observer's-place mechanism in a THIRD, independently built monogenic model of K (ℤ[s]=O_K, index 1), cross-gated against B931's two earlier models with a p-adic Newton-lift belt agreeing 10/10.
claims.evidence: frontier/B918_v_kummer/FINDINGS.md stage 1-3 + tier statement (lines 35-165); frontier/B923_exactification/FINDINGS.md §3 + 'the second discovery' (lines 66-103); frontier/B937_golden_and_29/FINDINGS.md instrument-upgrade section (lines 32-53); docs/LAW_MAP.md rows 202-203 (quoted verbatim above); arc_verdict.json for B918/B923/B937 all verdict=PROVED (the 'Status: DRAFT' banner on each FINDINGS.md header names the pre-banking authoring stage, not the bank status — each carries a banking-seat note, an arc_verdict.json PROVED, a LAW_MAP row, and a locked test: tests/test_b918_v.py, tests/test_b923_exact.py, tests/test_b936_b939.py). My own gp session (K=nfinit(x^3-12*x-5)): idealprimedec(K,953)=[[e=1,f=1],[e=1,f=2]] exactly, confirming 953's [1,2] split independently of the bench-fact block.

claims.statement: ELEMENT 2A — THE TRANSPORT TO λ AT D2: BANKED-COVERED, via two INDEPENDENT proofs of two DISTINCT objects that converge on the same place. λ (B916's |c|/√|h_ih_jh_k|) is not V; B918's Hensel-lift proof never mentions it. What licenses treating '953 = a pure value place' as applying to λ at D2 specifically is a second, separately-derived theorem: B931 ('THE 953 STRUCTURE THEOREM,' LAW_MAP row 207) computes the ideal divisor of d_S — the per-line twist ratio whose K/ℚ-norm IS λ_D2 (B916: λ=|N(d)|^{-1/2}=2304/953) — by an entirely different route (a resultant Res(h_S, prim(Q′)) of the twisted-form interference, not a Hensel lift of V's own root), and finds (d_S) = 𝔓₁(953)²·(2,3-poles): the SAME degree-one place 𝔭₁ that carries V's pole. Two independent computations, two different objects (V and d_S), one place. At D2 alone, the transport is doubly secured, not merely asserted.
claims.evidence: frontier/B916_lambda_bridge/FINDINGS.md 'Where 953 lives' (lines 61-73); frontier/B931_why_953/FINDINGS.md Headline 4 (lines 96-127, the divisor map (d_S)=P1(953)^2·Q1(2)^-4 Q2(2)^-6 p3^-4); docs/LAW_MAP.md row 207.

claims.statement: ELEMENT 2B — THE TRANSPORT TO λ AT χ_a, χ_b: NOT BANKED at the mechanism level; only the final rational values are banked. No arc anywhere in frontier/ runs a B931-style divisor-map / resultant-birth computation for χ_a's or χ_b's own twist ratios (grep across frontier/ for a 'why 413' or 'why 3047' analysis returns nothing; B928's D_a, D_b diagonals and B1076's λ(χ_a)=864/413, λ(χ_b)=6912/3047 are computed by re-running B923's already gauge-generic pipeline, which proves the NUMBERS exactly but does not explain, at the ideal level, WHY 7 lands where it does for χ_a or WHY 11 lands where it does for χ_b — the exact analogue of what B931 supplied for D2's 953 has never been built. So: calling '953→413→3047 the same law' is a NEW step. The raw arithmetic (below, claim 4) is fully banked-exact; the claim that a THEOREM (as opposed to an observed number) governs χ_a/χ_b's denominators is not.
claims.evidence: grep -rn 'divisor map\|resultant' frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/ frontier/B928_d2_decode/ — no chi_a/chi_b-specific ideal-factorization work found; frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/FINDINGS.md + b1076_results.json 'ext' claim 5 states explicitly: 'no evident simple arithmetic relation [among 953,413,3047] — registered open, not investigated further here.'

claims.statement: ELEMENT 3 — THE SELECTION STATEMENT, independently re-verified exactly in-sandbox (not merely cited). K=ℚ[s]/(s³−12s−5): disc(poly)=disc(nf)=6237=3⁴·7·11 (index²=1, confirming O_K=ℤ[s] maximal, the C28-corrected/B937-monogenic model). Splitting (via genuine algebraic factorization, gp nfinit+idealprimedec, not floats): p=3 → one prime, (e=3,f=1), totally ramified; p=7 → two primes, (e=1,f=1)+(e=2,f=1) — ramified but only TAMELY and only on one of its two places, not totally; p=11 → same shape as 7; p=59, p=277, p=953 → each two primes, (e=1,f=1)+(e=1,f=2) — unramified, shape exactly [1,2], and Kronecker(77,p)=−1 for all three (inert in the resolvent ℚ(√77), the transposition Frobenius class). λ's three non-identity values (B1076, adversarially confirmed to ~1e-80 by a fully independent numeric route): λ(D2)=2304/953=2⁸3²/953, λ(χ_a)=864/413=2⁵3³/(7·59), λ(χ_b)=6912/3047=2⁸3³/(11·277) — all three verified in lowest terms (gcd=1 each) with pairwise-coprime denominators (953·413·3047=1199265683, matching the adversarial check's own product exactly). THE TEST: does λ's denominator consist entirely of unramified [1,2] primes? D2: 953 alone — PASSES. χ_a: contains 7, one of K's exactly three ramified primes — FAILS. χ_b: contains 11, K's other non-3 ramified prime — FAILS. The disqualifying primes are exactly {7,11}, one per failing gauge, with zero overlap (χ_a's cofactor 59 and χ_b's cofactor 277 are themselves unramified/value-shaped, not ramified) and the third ramified prime 3 never appears bare in any denominator — it sits, every time, in the numerator (2304=2⁸·3², 864=2⁵·3³, 6912=2⁸·3³ all carry a power of 3).
claims.evidence: This session's gp transcript: nfinit(x^3-12*x-5) gives disc 6237 = disc(poly), 6237=factor→[3,4;7,1;11,1]; idealprimedec at 3,7,11,59,277,953 gives exactly the (e,f) pairs quoted; kronecker(77,953)=kronecker(77,59)=kronecker(77,277)=-1; sympy factorint(413)={7:1,59:1}, factorint(3047)={11:1,277:1}, gcd(864,413)=gcd(6912,3047)=gcd(2304,953)=1; 413*3047*953=1199265683 (python, matches b1076_results.json check-stage value verbatim). Source values: frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/b1076_results.json 'ext' claims 2-3 and 'check' stage (independent route, diffs 8.4e-81); frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/FINDINGS.md.

claims.statement: SUPPLEMENTARY, freshly computed this session (not in any FINDINGS.md): the numerator-leakage asymmetry sharpens the D2/χ_a,χ_b distinction beyond the bare denominator test. Factoring the HIER-analog e1/e2/e3 numerators exactly: at D2, e1's numerator carries 13·421493 and e2's carries 17·1129 — primes wholly UNRELATED to 953; the pole prime 953 never reappears anywhere else in HIER's coefficients. At χ_a, e1's numerator is 2⁴·3⁷·7²·448249 — the RAMIFIED prime 7 (part of χ_a's own denominator 413=7·59) reappears, squared, inside e1; e2's numerator (2¹³3¹¹·4219) and e3 (2²⁰3¹⁵, pure {2,3}) do not carry it. At χ_b, e1's numerator is 2⁸·3⁶·11²·521·224891 — the ramified prime 11 (part of 3047=11·277) likewise reappears squared in e1; e2 (2²¹3¹¹·64283) and e3 (2³²3¹⁵, pure {2,3}) do not. So in both failing gauges the SAME ramified prime that contaminates the denominator also leaks into e1's numerator — a form of entanglement with K's ramification that D2's 953 provably does not exhibit (953 is denominator-only, everywhere). The unramified cofactors (59, 277) behave like 953: denominator-only, never reappearing. This is exact, checkable arithmetic; it is NOT a mechanism (no valuation argument was run to explain WHY e1 specifically reuses the ramified prime while e2 does not), and it has not been stress-tested against any control.
claims.evidence: sympy factorint on the exact HIER-analog coefficients from frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/b1076_results.json 'pipe' claim 3 (chi_a: [29093783761, 768571321392, 6122563117056, 15045919506432]; chi_b: [86196536755681, 2645834425369344, 23881403546468352, 61628086298345472]) cross-checked against B918's HIER coefficients [824843587681, -27609909080832, 264084438122496, -760840571584512] (all four re-derived by direct exponentiation in this session: 953^4, 413^4, 3047^4, 2^8·3^9·13·421493, 2^21·3^8·17·1129, 2^32·3^11 all match digit-for-digit).

claims.statement: ELEMENT 4 — THE PHYSICAL READING, in the corpus's own firewalled grammar. C28 ('the four-column concordance,' THEOREM_LEDGER.md, banked, its own section header states 'no physics value is claimed anywhere below'): the object's four torus charges x₈,x₁₆,x₁₄,x₂₂ carry exponents 4,8,7,11; {x₈,x₁₆} (4,8) are 'measured' (θ-odd, split/real spectrum); {x₁₄,x₂₂} (7,11) are 'unmeasured' (compact/imaginary); '7·11=77=the resolvent' is stated in C28 itself, independently of anything about coboundary gauges (this theorem predates B1076 by weeks, built from B894/B898's torus-charge/discriminant-sign census, not from HIER or λ at all). So the two primes disqualifying χ_a and χ_b in claim 4 — 7 and 11 — are, by an independently-derived banked theorem, exactly the exponents this object's own grammar already labels 'unmeasured.' Stated at the level the corpus licenses: the ONE gauge whose value arithmetic touches none of the object's own 'unmeasured' exponents is the SAME gauge B918 already isolated by Hensel-lift computation; the two gauges whose arithmetic does touch an unmeasured exponent are exactly the two new failures — two independently-computed facts (C28 from the torus census; the denominator test from K's ramification) landing on the same pair of primes. Read this way: IF this denominator-purity criterion is the right selection rule, the gauge-datum question is answered by structure internal to the object (its own ramified/resolvent primes coinciding with its own already-named unmeasured directions), with no external empirical input invoked. That conditional ('if this criterion is the right one') is exactly what is not proved — see claims 8-10.
claims.evidence: The C28 citation and the exponent/prime identity (7=exponent of x₁₄, 11=exponent of x₂₂, both independently in the record before B1076) are exact and banked: docs/THEOREM_LEDGER.md lines ~251-259 (C28 verbatim, quoted above); TERMINOLOGY.md 'the dial' entry (m∈{4,8}=θ-odd); frontier/B894_meditation_trio/FINDINGS.md lines 44-58 (the x8/x16/x14/x22 table, 'the unmeasured pair's exponents multiply to 77'). The INTERPRETIVE sentence ('the gauge-datum question is answered internally') is my synthesis per the task's instruction, not a statement found or endorsed anywhere in the bank — no arc combines C28 with B1076's coset sweep.

claims.statement: ELEMENT 5 — SCOPE FENCES, explicit. NOT claimed: (i) No measured/SM number enters anywhere in this analysis — every quantity graded above is an internal ratio of the object's own algebra (λ, K's ramification data); Gate 5 stands untouched, consistent with B1076's own note that 'no experimental/measured number was read, cited, or compared at any point.' (ii) The hierarchy's ACTUAL VALUES stay exactly where B1076 left them: gauge-internal mathematics. B1076's own verdict is NEGATIVE at the coset level — 'no coset-invariant, value-bearing, mass-ratio-shaped residue exists' — and this task does not reopen that verdict. The selection test above picks out a GAUGE (an arithmetic property of which coboundary element's denominator is 'clean'); it says nothing about whether D2's specific v_g² triple is 'the' physical mass hierarchy, and nothing in this analysis converts a gauge-selection observation into a value claim. (iii) The selection is at most a CONSISTENCY observation — D2 is the unique non-degenerate gauge among the three tested whose denominator avoids K's ramified set — not a derivation of D2 from first principles, not a proof that no other coboundary-adjacent or Z¹-adjacent gauge could share the property (B1076's own class-(1,0)/(0,1) controls were mostly singular, undefined, not clean negatives), and not a proof that 'avoid the ramified set' is the criterion nature (or the object) is forced to use rather than one of possibly several exact-sounding criteria nobody has tried. (iv) C28 is filed, by its own text, as pure structure; combining it with the gauge test (claim 6) does not upgrade either into a physics claim — the combination is flagged there as PROPOSED-NOT-BANKED precisely to keep it on the firewalled side.
claims.evidence: frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/b1076_results.json 'ext' notes ('Gate 5 respected: no experimental/measured number was read, cited, or compared'); frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/FINDINGS.md verdict section ('NO coset-invariant, value-bearing, mass-ratio-shaped residue exists'); docs/THEOREM_LEDGER.md C28 section header; WORKING_RULES.md rule 6 (Gate 5).

claims.statement: ELEMENT 6A — MB12, THE MINIMAL TWO-OUTCOME CHECK. The criterion can fail, and does, twice (χ_a, χ_b) — the bare vacuity floor is cleared. What would have VOIDED it: (a) ALL THREE PASSING — if χ_a and χ_b had also produced single, unramified, [1,2]-split denominators, 'the law's shape' would hold at every non-degenerate gauge, exactly the fate B1076 proved for its OTHER coset-wide candidate in this same session: disc(HIER)'s squarefree part = 77 holds at D2, χ_a, χ_b, AND three unrelated MB12 control diagonals with zero relation to the coboundary structure, because it is FORCED — any generator of the same fixed field K has minimal-polynomial-discriminant differing from disc(K) by a rational square, a pure field-theoretic fact with nothing to do with which gauge produced the generator. Universal-pass here would have signaled the identical disease: field-forced, gauge-blind, not a selector. (b) ALL THREE FAILING — impossible without contradicting B918's independently pre-existing, Hensel-lift-certified theorem for D2 (claim 1); this arm was excluded before B1076 ran the sweep, not decided by it — B1076's live, undetermined question was only whether χ_a and χ_b would ALSO pass (making the pattern vacuous) or fail (making it a genuine 1-of-3 split). It came out as the latter.
claims.evidence: frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/b1076_results.json 'ext' claim 1 (the vacuity kill of the 77-pattern, MB12 controls quoted verbatim: 'PROVEN VACUOUS ... forced purely by V_ccl always living in the fixed field K ... holds even for a control diagonal with zero relation to the coboundary/character structure'); claim 1 in this list (B918's D2-only certificate, pre-dating B1076 by 6 weeks).

claims.statement: ELEMENT 6B — WHY THIS PATTERN IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY THE SAME KIND OF VACUOUS AS 77 (a structural reason, plus a supplementary, non-decisive control I ran myself). The killed 77-pattern is a FIELD invariant: disc(minimal poly) mod squares is the same for ANY generator of the SAME K, a pure index/change-of-basis fact, blind by construction to which gauge produced the generator — that is exactly why it says nothing about coboundaries. The denominator-prime-content tested here is an ELEMENT invariant: it depends on which specific twisted resultant a given gauge produces, and there is no analogous 'true for any generator' theorem forcing it — B931's own derivation of D2's 953 is a concrete, gauge-specific resultant computation, not a field-level fact. So there is no a priori reason excluding this criterion from carrying real gauge information, unlike 77. As a supplementary (not pre-registered, not decisive) spot-check in the same spirit as B1076's own MB12 controls, I factored B1076's own two already-computed off-B¹/off-Z¹ 'control' λ values: controlA = 24606358239/12111475315, denominator 5·199·3461·3517 (four unrelated mid-size primes, none of them 2,3,7,11,59,277,953), numerator 3·41·47·163·26113 (not 2,3-smooth); controlA3 = 3398045192/1223153581, denominator 13·953·98729 (three primes — including 953, but also 13 and an unrelated large prime, so NOT the clean single-unramified-prime shape), numerator 2³·167·881·2887 (not 2,3-smooth). Neither control has the clean shape at all, on either half of the test (numerator or denominator) — weak evidence (n=2, opportunistic reuse of controls built for a different purpose, not a designed sweep) but a genuine, independently-computed data point against 'any rational λ from this pipeline looks like this.'
claims.evidence: The structural argument (element- vs field-invariant) is a direct reading of B918/B931's own method (gauge-specific Hensel lift / resultant, not a field-level formula) versus the extraction agent's own explicit vacuity proof for 77 (frontier/B1076_coboundary_sweep/b1076_results.json 'ext' claim 1, 'a classical fact ... disc(minimal polynomial of beta) = disc(K) * (rational)^2 ALWAYS'). The control factorizations are my own sympy computation this session on the exact fractions recorded in 'ext' claim 0's evidence field ('control_A_generic_offB1: lambda=24606358239/12111475315 ... controlA3: lambda=3398045192/1223153581'). Graded PROPOSED-NOT-BANKED because the inference drawn (probably non-vacuous) exceeds what an unregistered, n=2, repurposed control can rigorously establish — a real verdict needs the same pre-registered MB12 sweep B1076 gave its other two candidates, which has not been run for this one.

claims.statement: ELEMENT 6C / OVERALL VERDICT ON BANK-WORTHINESS. 'THE GAUGE-SELECTION THEOREM' should NOT be typed as a theorem in the sense B918, B923, B931, or B937 are theorems. Every individual number in it is exact and independently reproduced (claims 4-5); the pattern clears the minimal vacuity floor (claim 8) and has a structural reason to be non-vacuous plus one supportive, non-decisive spot-check (claim 9); the physical-language convergence with C28 is real and exact at the level of 'which primes' (claim 6). But three things a LAW_MAP row would require are missing: (1) a mechanism for χ_a/χ_b's denominators analogous to B931's resultant-birth account of D2's 953 (claim 3) — without it, 'the same law governs all three' is an analogy, not a proof; (2) a designed, pre-registered MB12 control sweep for THIS specific criterion, of the kind B1076 gave CCC=3!λ and the 77-pattern in the same session — my claim-9 check is suggestive, not that sweep; (3) an argument for WHY 'avoid K's ramified primes' is the correct selection criterion rather than one of possibly several criteria that would also happen to single out D2 post hoc from a sample of three. Until those three are supplied, the correct typing is: an exactly-computed, precisely-stated, adversarially-untested-as-a-unit OBSERVATION — real, worth registering, not yet a theorem.
claims.evidence: Synthesis of claims 1-9 above; cross-checked against this repo's own bar for LAW_MAP admission (docs/LAW_MAP.md header: 'only ~4% cite a test lock ... locate its arc and its lock before building on it') and against WORKING_RULES.md rule 8 (vacuity-check before sealing) and rule 12 (an unearned negative is as bad as numerology — symmetric reading applied to an unearned positive/theorem label).

f.fail_witnesses: Three concrete snags hit and resolved during this session, reported plainly: (1) My first two PARI/GP scripts for idealprimedec failed on multi-line for-loop syntax (a tooling artifact of how `gp -q file` reads multi-statement for-loop bodies split across lines, not a math error) — resolved by rewriting each loop on a single physical line; the final run (verify_K4.gp) is clean and its output (p=3→[[3,1]]; p=7,11→[[1,1],[2,1]]; p=59,277,953→[[1,1],[1,2]]) is what every claim above rests on. (2) A minor, non-load-bearing terminology imprecision caught in B1076's own extraction claim 1: it labels the number 2^32·3^10·5^2·7^3·11·13^12 (=557339020487762273068236197068800, independently reproduced here) 'disc(K)' — this is actually disc(μ13), the non-maximal-order MODEL polynomial's discriminant, not the field discriminant disc(K)=6237 (they differ by index²=2^32·3^6·5^2·7^2·13^12, a perfect square). This is the same error SHAPE that E41/C28 corrected one day earlier in this repo (model invariant read as field invariant) — but here it is harmless: the actual claim being made (squarefree kernel = 77) is true of BOTH numbers, by the exact 'any generator of K differs by a rational square' argument the extraction agent itself proves and uses, so B1076's 77-vacuity conclusion is unaffected. Flagged for completeness, not as a strike against B1076's verdict. (3) No failure witness exists for the core arithmetic: every factorization, gcd, Kronecker symbol, and splitting-type computation in claims 4-5 was cross-checked by at least two independent tools (PARI/GP nfinit+idealprimedec for the algebraic number theory; Python sympy factorint/gcd for the elementary arithmetic) and, where B1076 supplied a number, against that arc's own adversarial 'check' stage (independent numeric route, residuals ~1e-80) — no disagreement found anywhere.

B1076 itself carries verdict=NEGATIVE (the mass-ratio lane is closed, correctly, at the coset-invariance question) but its individual computed numbers (λ at all four gauges, the HIER-analog cubics, the gcd/coprimality data) are adversarially held (3-agent, independent-reimplementation verify, holds=true) and are treated here as fully reliable raw material — a negative-verdict arc's positive sub-results are exactly what claim 5 of B923 and this task both build on, consistent with WORKING_RULES rule 10's sub-lemma-harvest discipline. v.item: THE GAUGE-SELECTION THEOREM (formalized): B918's observer's-place law (den(V)=𝔭₁(953)⁴, proved only at gauge D2) vs. B1076's 3-gauge coboundary sweep {D2,χ_a,χ_b} with λ-denominators {953, 413=7·59, 3047=11·277} — adversarial re-verification of the "avoid K's ramified primes {3,7,11}" selection claim, typed PROPOSED-NOT-BANKED / OBSERVATION (not THEOREM) by the formalization itself.
v.finding:
VERDICT: HOLDS at its typed grade.
